question: Does the task-first compositional relay retain substantial, information-identifiable value beyond fully trained conventional causal Bayesian, recurrent predictive, and empirical model-based RL controls with the same physically charged training experience, genuinely unseen causal-law families, and cold persistent-law restoration?

scope.forbidden: Changes to existing MD29/MD30/MD31/MD32 sources/outcomes/thresholds, main, accepted refs, Yggdrasil native weights, loop/controller, runner, scheduler, official first-use, Wingless, Hybrid or FORGE.
scope.authority: External synthetic contribution and CI only; official/registered first-use separately owner-authorized, not covered by standing next gate.

synthetic_cohorts.generator: Reuse immutable MD32 RelayWorld(spec, rewire) physics with a new synthetic-only wrapper that refuses any seed outside declared 11000..11767, 12000..12191, 13000..13191, 14000..14095 and never calls MD32.fixture_spec or official dataset generator.
synthetic_cohorts.allocation: For each cohort, block=floor((seed-first)/4), context=(seed-first)%4; motif=cohort_motifs[block%3], offset=floor(block/3)%4, rewired=(floor(block/12)%2)==1. Four episodes per block share hidden law and change status; agents may reset at publicly declared block boundary, not see block index/seed/motif/offset/rewire. Every train and heldout block uses four different required precursors.
synthetic_cohorts.heldout_restriction: Transfer and cold are separate synthetic research diagnostics; do not use them to choose thresholds, architecture, epochs, hyperparameters, or select policies after observing outcomes.
synthetic_cohorts.split_structural_disjointness: train/val use relay, fork, collider; transfer/cold use braid, inhibitor, crossbridge; all six mechanism pairs source-frozen in MD32.
synthetic_cohorts.risk: Law families and offsets are fixed; saturating the four-state task is possible. Identifiability does not prove learning/AGI.

paid_data.training_exposure: Frozen public two-mechanism-probe demonstration policy only: for each of 768 training episodes, charge encoder probe, irreversible precursor actuator, decoder probe and terminal actuator. Each of 3072 action/observation/reward rows recorded in physical order; no private graph, motif, label, seed or offset returned to model.
paid_data.memory_boundary: reset per four-episode block, persistent within block; cold restoration must retain train-fitted parameters but reset current block state before new four-episode evaluation; no cumulative heldout learning of global weights.
paid_data.equivalent_info: All controls and reference get same live public obs, paid action menu, real step costs and episode/within-block boundaries, no metadata of hidden family/status.
paid_data.equivalent_compute: All process CPU seconds, training actions and per-decision model calls reported. Compute capacities are NOT assumed equal; any scientific superiority claim is prohibited without separately matched compute budget and independent qualifying strongest controls.

controls.handcoded_reference: Use unchanged MD32 run_public_two_probe, exactly two charged probes per episode; expected +0.800 reward; privileged oracle only for posthoc task ceiling +0.960.
controls.blind: Use unchanged MD32 run_public_blind, no diagnostic, expected -0.165.

bayesian.type: Conventional factorized Dirichlet categorical response model for encoder[a] and effective decoder[h], global posterior trained on all paid training probes; independent memory counts for actual paid observations within each four-episode block. Never uses hidden episode mechanism.
bayesian.training_order: ascending 11000..11767 with four actions per episode, only public encoder/decoder sensor receipts
bayesian.planning: For encoder and decoder independently, predict most probable output from fitted counts plus within-block paid-response memory. Physically probe if max predictive probability below 0.94666667. Never simulate World.step, and avoid actions based on hidden labels.
bayesian.cold_checkpoint: Serialize all 8x4 learned channel-counts and model contract, then reload for independent cold scoring; within-block memory reset.

recurrent.type: Fully trainable Elman tanh recurrent categorical physical world model; public paid-probe sensor prediction with full BPTT, persistent hidden state across the four context-varied episodes of each block.
recurrent.training_data: Train sees only 192 public four-episode (eight charged probes per block) response sequences, 48 separate public validation blocks; no graph labels, no future outcomes.
recurrent.training_loss: Cross-entropy over 4-way physical probe outputs; at each step predict from preceding hidden state + probe mechanism and channel, then update hidden only after actual observed public sensor, truncated only at block boundary.
recurrent.action_policy: Retain exact within-block memory of observed physical probe responses. If channel previously probed, skip diagnostic using paid memory. Otherwise use trained recurrent softmax, skip probe only if confidence>=0.94666667; if not, pay real diagnostic. No simulated observation inserted into hidden state.
recurrent.stop: Stop on frozen validation patience or 80 epochs; report train and validation cross-entropy and exact selected epoch. A finite but high loss is an engineering negative, not automatically strong baseline.

model_based_rl.type: Conventional empirical action-conditioned finite-state world model and 1-step Bellman value-of-information planning; train maximum-likelihood categorical transition probabilities from the same 3072 paid training actions. Public block memory only from paid probes.
model_based_rl.probability_features: mechanism (encoder/decoder), channel 0..3; public predicted outcome one-hot 0..3; plus deterministic episodic paid-memory count for within-block previously observed mechanism/channel
model_based_rl.planning: For each stage compare expected terminal correct-action value after a real paid diagnostic against immediate best actuarial decision, using no unrewarded simulated World.step. Probe if expected value of information exceeds cost 0.08. No more than one physical probe per mechanism.
model_based_rl.cold_checkpoint: Preserve fitted categorical table and audited physical trace SHA, reset episode/block transient memory.

metrics: net utility mean and paired episode-level delta
whole-process train/eval CPU and checkpoint size
one_shot_protocol.primary: Task is TRIVIAL_FOR_NOVEL_GAIN if strongest fully trained conventional control mean net utility >=0.91 on BOTH transfer and cold (oracle 0.96 minus at most 0.05); retain evidence and stop novelty. Separately the handcoded reference +0.8 is non-learning; if no fully trained control beats it, control adequacy remains unverified.
one_shot_protocol.otherwise: If trained controls achieve mean score at least +0.05 over blind in all three transfer motifs and strong reference remains <=0.91, task shows exploratory room but not a scientific gain. May continue pre-first-use design work; no model promotion.
one_shot_protocol.negative: If heldout transfer of fully trained controls is weak, divergent, nonfinite or worse than handcoded in crucial motifs, classify CONTROLS_UNDERQUALIFIED/DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO and do not assert useful unconventional headroom.
one_shot_protocol.science: No original scientific first-use and NO SCIENTIFIC_PASS in this experiment. Do not tune on transfer/cold, even if negative.

engineering.source_lock: Exact prereg-only SHA must precede source; no prereg modifications after it; preserve MD29/MD30/MD31/MD32 completely.
qualify: G29 code atlas only after source commit
cross-OS portable exact physical action traces and classifications, model numerical rounding called out if not equal
